levothyroxine.timing_note: Take 30–60 min before breakfast on an empty stomach
levothyroxine.warning: Calcium, iron, and magnesium block levothyroxine absorption. Avoid dairy, fortified foods, and supplements within 4h of dose.

metformin.timing_note: Take with meals to reduce GI side effects
metformin.warning: Long-term metformin use may reduce vitamin B12 and folate absorption. Consider B12 monitoring and supplementation.

warfarin.timing_note: Maintain consistent vitamin K intake — do not drastically increase or decrease
warfarin.warning: Vitamin K (found in leafy greens) directly affects warfarin efficacy. Do not drastically change your intake of vitamin K-rich foods.

simvastatin.timing_note: Take in the evening; avoid grapefruit
simvastatin.warning: Statins may deplete CoQ10. Grapefruit inhibits statin metabolism — avoid entirely.

atorvastatin.timing_note: Can be taken any time of day; avoid grapefruit
atorvastatin.warning: Statins may deplete CoQ10. Grapefruit inhibits statin metabolism — avoid entirely.

omeprazole.warning: Long-term PPI use may impair absorption of magnesium, B12, vitamin C, iron, and calcium. Consider monitoring if used long-term.

esomeprazole.warning: Long-term PPI use may impair absorption of magnesium, B12, vitamin C, iron, and calcium.

ciprofloxacin.timing_note: Take 2h before or 6h after dairy/mineral-rich foods
ciprofloxacin.warning: Dairy and mineral-rich foods significantly reduce ciprofloxacin absorption. Take on an empty stomach when possible.

ibuprofen.timing_note: Take with food or milk to reduce stomach irritation
ibuprofen.warning: Take with food to reduce GI irritation. Avoid alcohol. Long-term use may affect vitamin C status.

sertraline.timing_note: Can be taken with or without food
sertraline.warning: Avoid alcohol. Grapefruit juice may increase sertraline levels. In rare cases, SSRIs can cause low sodium.

prednisone.timing_note: Take with food to reduce stomach upset; take in the morning
prednisone.warning: Corticosteroids deplete calcium, vitamin D, potassium, and other nutrients. Ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D intake. Limit sodium and alcohol.

lisinopril.timing_note: Can be taken with or without food
lisinopril.warning: ACE inhibitors increase potassium retention. Avoid potassium supplements and salt substitutes. Long-term use may deplete zinc.

amlodipine.timing_note: Can be taken with or without food
amlodipine.warning: Grapefruit juice can increase amlodipine levels and side effects — avoid entirely.

furosemide.timing_note: Take in the morning to avoid nighttime urination
furosemide.warning: Loop diuretics cause significant loss of potassium, magnesium, and other electrolytes. Increase intake of potassium-rich foods (bananas, avocado, sweet potato).
